Revise: the same winding grey ribbon of asphalt, and this time the racing cars have detailed, varied vehicle shapes.
statement: I created a scrolling view of racing cars on a winding asphalt road using isometric 2D graphics. The road snakes through the landscape using cubic Bézier curves with randomly generated control points, creating natural turns and varying curvature. Cars are rendered as colorful shapes with motion trails that show their path and speed. I used perspective scaling based on vertical screen position to simulate depth—cars lower on screen appear larger. The track is drawn with width by offsetting vertices along perpendicular tangents to the path. Each car has distinct colors and sizes, moving at different speeds along the parameterized curve.
